summary: Self-duality of x ↦ ψ_f(−x/ϖ): its conductor is Ô because (ϖ) is the different.

steps.claim: selfDualChar(ra) = ψ_f(−ra/ϖ); by forall_ψf_mul_eq_one, ψ_f(r·(−a/ϖ)) = 1 for all r ∈ Ô iff d·(−a/ϖ) ∈ Ô for every d in the different (ϖ) of E, iff a ∈ Ô. (The direction ⇒ takes r = 1 times a; ⇐ uses that Ô·a ⊆ Ô.)
steps.lean:
simpa [selfDualChar, map_eq_one_iff coeHom @Circle.ext, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← mul_neg,
    forall_ψf_mul_eq_one, ← Algebra.mul_smul_comm, S.span_ϖ, Ideal.mem_span_singleton',
    -algebraMap_smul] using ⟨(one_mul a ▸ · 1), fun h _ ↦ mul_mem (coe_mem_Ô _) h⟩
